# Jubilees Chapter 36 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 36:6 — Mastema's role

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "let not the spirit of Mastema rule over you" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "Do not let the spirit of Mastema have dominion over you" | "Dominion" stronger than "rule" |
| PNEUMA | "Don't let Mastema's spirit take hold of you" | Dynamic but weakens "dominion" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "have dominion" — the Ge'ez term is a strong sovereignty word, stronger than "rule." PNEUMA's "take hold" is too weak for a cosmic dominion verb.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 36:10 — "from the river to the sea"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "from the river to the sea" | Literal; which river unspecified |
| LOGOS | "from the river to the sea" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "from the great river to the sea" | Adds "great" to specify the Euphrates |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET/LOGOS "from the river to the sea" without "great." The Ge'ez does not include the qualifier; PNEUMA's addition is interpretive.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 36:12 — "I will curse thee in my death" vs. "at my death"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "I will curse thee in my death" | Literal Ge'ez |
| LOGOS | "I will curse you at my death" | "At my death" more natural |
| PNEUMA | "I will curse you with my last breath" | Dynamic, vivid |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "at my death." EMET's "in my death" is a Ge'ez idiom that sounds awkward in English. PNEUMA's "last breath" is evocative but goes beyond the Ge'ez.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
